description: Searches and filters TokenBank instruments for earning yield with crypto. The default scope is the curated tier (rows that state a yield, minimum and risk); the tier parameter extends it to the imported issuer-catalogue rows (tokenized treasuries, yield stablecoins, gold, real estate, tokenized stocks, staking, DeFi/CeFi earn, alternative funds), which carry identity and classification only. Returns compact records with paging.

max_risk.description: Maximum risk on a 1-5 scale (1=very low, 3=medium, 5=high)

offset.description: Number of matches to skip; the nextOffset of a previous answer continues from there (absent at the end).

query.description: Free-text match on name, ticker, issuer or type

tier.description: Which tier to search. Default "curated": instruments that state a yield, minimum and risk. "imported" and "all" add the issuer-catalogue rows, which carry identity and classification only (no yield).

name: search_yield_products

nextOffset.description: Pass as offset to fetch the next page; absent when there is no more

totalMatching.description: Rows that matched before the limit

title: Search yield products
